text:
joel: kicking off staged rollout for ripple-run (v2.3.7-hotfix). plan: 3% -> 10% over 30m. change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. deploying to us-east-1 first.

deploy-bot: deploy started for v2.3.7-hotfix -> routing 3% traffic to new variant. rollout id: rl-2026-03-21-01

maya: watching perf dashboards now. will flag on any 95p latency or error spike.

sam: smoke tests queued, running basic combo set (auth + embed + chat-simple).

dan: heads up — I see a small auth error bump from 0.12% -> 0.95% in one pod. tagging it but not immediate blocker.

maya: 95p latency +120ms on session-store RPC for the same pod, correlating with auth errs.

joel: ok let's hold at 3% while we triage. dan, can you check the pod logs and KV cache pressure? we should pin traffic if this is a progressive regression.

dan: digging in. log snippet shows repeated timeouts to session-store:
```
ERR: grpc deadline exceeded (session-store) shard=us-east-1a
KV_CACHE: miss-rate +18% over baseline
```

ops-runbook-bot: recommended quick actions: 1) pause rollout 2) pin traffic to previous variant v2.3.6 3) run targeted smoke on failing shard. command templates below.

ops-runbook-bot: pause command: `deployctl rollout pause --id rl-2026-03-21-01 --reason "hold: session-store timeouts"`
ops-runbook-bot: pin command: `routingctl pin --route /api/v1/* --to-version v2.3.6 --shard us-east-1a`

deploy-bot: received pause request from joel. executing pause...

deploy-bot: rollout rl-2026-03-21-01 paused at 3% (user: joel). state=PAUSED. note="hold: session-store timeouts"

joel: thanks. dan — go ahead with targeted smoke and capture full trace for session-store. maya/sam please run the gold prompt eval and auth smoke on that shard.

maya: running evals now. will post failures. ETA ~4m.

sam: running auth smoke against us-east-1a now.

dan: capture collected. looks like a transient spike on session-store infra — increased GC + query fanout. filing infra ticket INFR-2345 and tagging infra-oncall.

dan: recommend pinning until infra patch is validated — otherwise we'll keep seeing tail latency increases as we open more traffic.

joel: consensus check: pin to v2.3.6 for us-east-1a and keep rollout paused globally until next window or infra clears? react with :thumbsup: to pin+hold, :thumbsdown: to abort pin (keep investigating).

maya: :thumbsup: pin+hold

sam: :thumbsup:

dan: :thumbsup:

joel: ok pin approved. executing pin now.

deploy-bot: routingctl invoked by joel. pin applied: /api/v1/* -> v2.3.6 on us-east-1a. routing change id rc-9876.

deploy-bot: note: rollout remains PAUSED. no further traffic increases will occur until manual resume.

joel: added short release note to the changelog: "paused ripple-run v2.3.7-hotfix due to session-store tail latency on us-east-1a; pinned affected shard to v2.3.6 while infra investigates."

sam: good call. also adding a QA note to block further canary expansion until INFR-2345 is resolved and GC mitigations are deployed.

ops-runbook-bot: rollback snippet if needed:
```
# rollback to v2.3.6 globally
deployctl rollback --id rl-2026-03-21-01 --to-version v2.3.6 --force --confirm
```

joel: for now we'll keep this thread as the single source. infra-oncall, please post updates here. reopen rollout when infra confirms fix and we re-run smoke+gold prompts.

dan: tagging infra-oncall @infra-oncall. created INFR-2345 with traces and heap profiles.

infra-oncall (bot): acknowledged INFR-2345. investigating GC tuning and connection pooling. ETA 45m initial triage.

maya: will re-run evals after triage. thanks everyone.

joel: final: change window note updated, release owner set to joel, status=PAUSED_PINNED. will follow up with status update timestamped in this thread.
